Happy Birthday

Happy, happy birthday to the best stepdad in the world, Dad Peter! ❤️

Thank you for being a father to me even though I am not your biological son. From day one until now, you have always been there for me and for our family. Thank you for all the love, effort, patience, understanding, sacrifices, and support you have given us through every situation.

I am truly sorry for the times when I became a burden to our family and for the moments when I gave you and Mom a headache. Please know that I never take everything you both have done for me for granted. I will always be grateful that God blessed me with a loving, kind, generous, and understanding Mom and Dad.

Thank you for every sacrifice you have made for me and for our family. Thank you for helping me finish college. Without both of you, I know that reaching this point would have been much harder. Thank you for all the advice you have given me throughout my life. I always try to keep your words in my heart and apply them to myself and to my future because they have helped me become a better person and prepare for the life ahead of me.

I am also grateful that you raised me with love and with the fear of God. You taught me things that are more valuable than money. As I grow older, I realize that parental love, sacrifice, guidance, and presence are things that no amount of wealth can replace.

Sometimes, I think that one day, these moments could become the memories that I will miss the most. While writing this message, I honestly feel like crying because I know that time passes so quickly, and you and Mom are getting older. My only wish is that God will continue to give you both a long and healthy life so that we can still spend many more years together.

Even though we are not always together, please know that I always pray for both of you before I go to sleep. I pray that God will protect you, give you more years to live, and allow you both to stay together for a very long time. I also pray for Lola and for the protection of our whole family because I love you all so much.

One day, I promise that I will be able to give back to both of you and make up for everything you have done for me. For now, I will continue doing my best and working hard to build a good future. I know I still have a lot to learn, but I will never forget all the lessons and sacrifices you have given me.

One Bible verse that I always keep in my heart is Isaiah 60:22:

"When the time is right, I, the Lord, will make it happen."

I truly believe that everything happens at the right time. Whenever I make a mistake or do something wrong, I feel guilty because I know when I have disappointed the people who love me. That is why I always try to learn from my mistakes, say sorry, and make sure that I do my best so the same mistake will not happen again.

And as we always say:

GOD IS GOOD ALL THE TIME. 🙏❤️

Thank you also for the birthday gift you gave me and for the ₱500. Thank you for still giving me an allowance even though I am no longer a student. I honestly appreciate it so much. I feel a little embarrassed receiving an allowance because I have already finished college, and I am no longer a student. I think this October might be the last time I receive an allowance because I really want to start working, especially since I am planning to look for a job in Manila and build my own future.

But no matter where life takes me, I will never forget everything you and Mom have done for me. I may not be able to repay everything right now, but I promise that I will always carry your love, sacrifices, advice, and lessons with me wherever I go.

Dad Peter, thank you for accepting me, raising me, guiding me, supporting me, and loving me as your own son. I may not be your biological son, but in my heart, you will always be my Dad.

Once again, Happy, Happy 73rd Birthday to the best stepdad in the world, Dad Peter! 🎂❤️

May God bless you with many more birthdays, more years to live, good health, happiness, peace, and countless blessings. I pray that God continues to protect you, Mom, and Lola, and that He allows all of us to make more beautiful memories together.

I love you both so much, Mom and Dad. Thank you for everything. I will always be grateful that I have you in my life.

With all my love,
Your Son,
Kevin Paul ❤️
